purpose: Choose bootstrap/repair versus post-setup readiness listing from observed installed state without allowing optional Hermes work to block the core fleet.

steps.name: resolve repository-owned surfaces
steps.rule: The repository root must be observed and contain .git plus these surfaces. Reject stale hard-coded profile paths before Git/setup.

steps.name: observe installed state
steps.rule: Do not invoke the post-setup launcher before these checks are classified.

steps.name: bootstrap or repair when required
steps.action: Use the core-autoconfig-defer-hermes workflow when Hermes is unavailable, hanging, or not a priority; otherwise use repository-owned full setup. Reuse healthy components and preserve setup-summary.json/setup-transcript.txt.
forbidden: manually copy agent-switchboard.cmd as a substitute for setup

steps.name: verify installed surfaces after setup
steps.rule: A partial setup is acceptable when the only deferred dependency is Hermes and the core surfaces exist.

steps.name: list readiness
steps.action: Invoke installed agent-switchboard.cmd -ListAgents or repository startup report. Treat Hermes unavailable as TBD/deferred; do not block other READY adapters.

steps.name: route next action
rules: Hermes unavailable/skipped/blocked with healthy core -> core-ready-hermes-deferred; record TBD and continue with non-Hermes READY adapters
verification-required -> preserve launch-time provider/model probe requirement
core BLOCKED/not-configured/unknown -> follow recorded setup/readiness guidance; do not launch work

proofCeiling: Proves deterministic state classification, optional-Hermes deferral routing, and the required next workflow. Runtime bootstrap success requires observed setup artifacts; agent/provider/Hermes success remains unproved.
